metadata.purpose: Non-degenerate 4-element witness for G2+FG2+FP-synt with the fixed point at p, not T or bot.
metadata.order_summary: bot < p < T and c < T, with c incomparable to bot and p.

metadata.warning: G2 holds vacuously because boxtimes(T)=p is not <= bot; this is still non-collapsed and non-degenerate with respect to fixed-point location.
